card.name: Start of the word triglycerides
card.fires_on: The first piece "Tr" or "tr" of the word triglycerides or triglyceridemia, in lipid tables and lipid-related warnings. It sometimes fires on "high" just before triglycerides.

modes.label: Lipid table row
modes.description: Capitalised "Tr" starting the Triglycerides row after cholesterol or HDL values.
modes.example: -2.7 -2.3 HDL n=112 n=98 Change from baseline -0.8 -2.6<< Tr>>iglycerides n=112

modes.label: Inside running text
modes.description: Lowercase "tr" starting triglycerides in parentheses or after hyper-.

card.writes: It adds little that is clear; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated to the word.
card.plain: It spots the start of the word triglycerides, mostly in lipid tables and in warnings about high blood fats.
